<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">

  <li><strong>Energy storage investment:</strong> The Union Cabinet approved a Rs 14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme to support 92 Gigawatt-hours of energy storage, aiming to bolster India’s clean energy infrastructure.</li>
